program_notes.worm_repurposing_screen: Page says 'worm model of MVA' (species unstated); C. elegans inferred from society-linked platform paper PMID:39773880. san-1 = MAD3/BubR1 worm ortholog (PMID:18248670).
program_notes.patient_fibroblasts: MVA-family skin-biopsy fibroblasts grown in London; mosaic culture gives an internal euploid control for aneuploidy-selectivity readouts.
program_notes.supplements_cell_health: Supplement testing on human MVA cells (USA).

entries.assay: Intermittent D+Q exposure (hit-and-run schedule per PMID:31542391) on MVA patient fibroblasts
entries.readout: SA-beta-gal/p16/p21+ fraction, SASP cytokine panel (IL-6, IL-8, IL-1a), aneuploidy rate (interphase FISH / scDNA-seq), micronuclei
entries.expected_direction: reduced senescent fraction and SASP; aneuploidy rate expected UNCHANGED (senolytics do not repair the SAC - a null result on aneuploidy is itself informative)
entries.go_no_go: GO if >=50% reduction in senescent-marker fraction with no rise in aneuploidy rate or cytotoxicity to euploid cells; NO-GO if nonselective toxicity
entries.rationale: The anchor senolysis study was performed in the BubR1-hypomorph model (PMID:22048312); patient fibroblasts are the nearest human system.

entries.expected_direction: down-shift of senescence modules
entries.go_no_go: GO if SASP modules significantly reduced vs untreated
entries.rationale: confirms pharmacodynamic knockdown at single-cell level

entries.assay: san-1(ok1580) or bub-3 mutant + dasatinib exposure
entries.readout: embryonic/larval viability, him rate, growth, behavioural tracking
entries.expected_direction: uncertain; worm lacks a classical senescent compartment - weak model fit for senolytics
entries.rationale: low expected mechanistic read-through; include only in a broad screen

entries.assay: chronic low-dose sirolimus on MVA patient fibroblasts
entries.readout: SASP cytokines, p-S6 (pharmacodynamic), aneuploidy rate, BubR1 protein, growth rate

entries.go_no_go: GO if SASP down >=30% with stable aneuploidy rate and no growth suppression; NO-GO on aneuploidy rise or cytostasis (a growth-retarded child cannot take a growth-suppressing drug)
entries.rationale: mTORC1 hyperactivity tracks MVA-mouse sarcopenia (PMID:31738183); SASP mechanism direct (PMID:26147250)

entries.expected_direction: possible lifespan extension (conserved TOR-longevity link)
entries.rationale: cheap pharmacodynamic confirmation

fibroblast_core_readouts: aneuploidy rate (interphase FISH panel / scDNA-seq / micronucleus index) - the disease-defining readout; the mosaic culture gives an internal euploid control
mitotic timing under nocodazole challenge (functional SAC strength)
SA-beta-gal / p16 / p21 senescent fraction + SASP cytokines (Axis-B pharmacodynamic)
decision_logic: Fibroblast assays are the decisive tier (T1 cost, disease-relevant cells, internal euploid control, 2-6 weeks). Worm assays are cheap whole-organism confirmation. scRNA-seq quantifies signature reversal. The supplements program is the natural home for NAD-precursor adjuncts. Any candidate showing an INCREASE in aneuploidy rate or micronuclei on patient cells is an automatic NO-GO regardless of other benefits.
